result.email_draft:
Subject: Fraud Alert: Payment Blocked for Invoice AC-8015

Dear Finance Manager,

Payment for invoice AC-8015 from Acme Office Supplies Ltd (V001), totaling USD 870.00, has been blocked due to a potential fraud concern.

The invoice requests payment to a bank account that differs from the account recorded in the vendor master. Please verify the payment details with the supplier by phone, using the known contact information on file. Do not use the phone number or any other contact details printed on the invoice.

Kindly confirm the supplier’s banking details before releasing the payment.

Regards,
